caption:
Pillow covers are cheap. The insert inside them is why yours look flat.

A decorative cover is only as good as what's stuffed in it. If your throw pillows sag in the middle or look half-empty at the corners, that's the insert, not the cover. Swapping inserts is the cheaper fix — you keep every cover you already own.

The Utopia Bedding 18x18 Pillow Inserts are standard 18-by-18 forms sized for the most common throw pillow cover on the market. With 218,437 reviews holding a 4.6-star average, this is a product a very large number of people have bought and rated well — that volume is about as close to a consensus as a basic home item gets.

You get filled-out pillows on the covers already sitting on your couch, without replacing a single one. $13.49.
